title: WALK WISELY
IN BUSY DAYS
end: The Guided Path — seek God's wisdom for every step

scenes.a: That crowded calendar is pressing on your mind.
See then that ye walk circumspectly, not as fools, but as wise,
scenes.sub: NOT AS FOOLS BUT AS WISE

scenes.a: Redeeming the time, because the days are evil.
Wherefore be ye not unwise, but understanding what the will of the Lord is.
Lord, teach me to walk thoughtfully through this busy day. Give me clear discernment to choose what truly matters and the courage to quiet every distraction.
Order my steps, guard my hours, and grant me wisdom to know Your will in each decision. In Jesus' name, Amen. That crowded calendar is pressing on your mind.
